precepts.text: By revelation he made known unto me the mystery: that the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel. That is the mystery: the animal sacrifice is done away with, and the northern and southern kingdom now have a chance to come back into the fold with Christ. The promises were not made through animal sacrifice but through Christ.
precepts.point: The riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory. The Gentiles here are the northern kingdom, who can come back into the fold. You had no hope unless Christ came and died for us. There was no repentance, no reconciliation, lest it be for Christ.

note.label: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.why:
Ephesians, Colossians and Philemon were written in the same period, around AD 60 to 67 while Paul was under house arrest in Rome, to the same region. That is why they overlap and speak of the same things, like this mystery.

“How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words, Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ) Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit; That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel.”

That is the mystery: the animal sacrifice is done away with, no longer in play, and the northern and southern kingdom now have a chance to come back into the fold with Christ. Partakers of his promise, the covenant: the promises were not made through animal sacrifice but through Christ. That is the same “mystery among the Gentiles” of Colossians 1:27, Christ in you, the hope of glory.

precepts.text: Rooted and grounded in love, to comprehend with all saints.
precepts.point: Prophesying is for edification, exhortation and comfort, so gifts are for the body and not for oneself.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
The gifts are given “For the perfecting of the saints”, and prophecy gives edification, exhortation and comfort. Paul prays for the same: “That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love, May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height; And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge”.

With all the saints you have to comprehend the breadth, the width, the length, the depth and the height. It goes into what the Lord has prepared for those of us that love him. Once you fully understand that, it gives you hope, exhorts you and comforts you to continue in this walk and not fall out and go back into the world.

Some brothers and sisters have been with us for years and say, I can't take it no more, five years and I ain't got none, and they go back into the world and let Satan overcome them. If you want a husband or a wife, go to the Lord first: pray and fast, Lord, send me a righteous sister, send me a righteous husband. But get yourself right first, or it is not coming your way. Sisters want an Abraham but are not like Sarah; brothers want a Sarah while still living with mama.

“that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God. Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us, Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end.” That world without end is the church, a precept with Isaiah 45. Rooted and grounded in love, we comprehend what the Lord has for us and are filled with his fulness.

points: To be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man, that Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith. It is all about strengthening that inner man. Bodily exercise profiteth little: in the context of the time, the Greeks and Romans idolized the perfect body, vanity. Maintaining the vessel matters, but what you must strengthen day by day is the inner man.

note.label: Daily Bread for a Dying Man

points: To be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man: if you believe this truth, he will strengthen your mind. The Lord will give you the power to overcome your lusts; if you keep falling into them, your belief is not there yet. You have to fight it within.

note.label: Shapen in Iniquity: Resetting the Nervous System

points: That ye might be filled with all the fulness of God: that deletes depression and anxiety. I do not sit around depressed anymore; I know who is in control of my steps, I understand what God called me to do, and I know I have brothers that love and care for me. When they correct me, I know it is not coming from a place of malice. But if you have not rewired your mind to believe that these are the men of God, every correction will send you right back into the old rut and the old excuses.

note.label: Shapen in Iniquity: Resetting the Nervous System

points: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named: that family is Israel, princes that have power with God. So when it says Jacob was gathered unto his people, it means he went to paradise. That is the hope and the comfort you have to have: when Jacob died he was not really dead, he went back to paradise.
The spirit of Christ has to dwell in you for it to be revealed, so do not expect everybody to understand what was covered tonight.
